title: Lakeside Marina
specs: Parasailing flights offer views of Lake Tahoe and Sierra Nevada Mountains
Sailing yacht is a 65' Macgregor Windsong with capacity for 24 passengers
Parasailing ages 5 and up; under 18 requires parent/guardian waiver
Parasailing weight limits approx. 50 to 300 pounds per person, combined 150 to 500 pounds
Jet ski rentals require age 21+ with valid driver's license; 16-17 can drive with license but no under 18 passengers
Boat rentals require age 24+ with valid driver's license
No one under influence of drugs or alcohol allowed on any activity
Pregnant persons not allowed on parasailing or jet ski rentals
